dogecoin.text: @vlayer_xyz Dogecoin is an outstanding example of human intervention in the market, while the other two are more the product of distraction.

@jillrgunter In 2021, Elon Musk's tweets caused Bitcoin prices to fluctuate sharply in the short term, and Dogecoin was also related. Not only that, Dogecoin even became popular in China's web2 world at the time, ranking at the top of the popularity on TikTok and Weibo.
